question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To beat the band

options.text: To a huge or the greatest possible extent.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To beat the band"** means to a huge or the greatest possible extent. (किसी चीज़ को बहुत ज्यादा या सबसे बड़े संभव हद तक करना) • **Example: **They were cheering to beat the band after their team scored the winning goal. • **"To beat the band" **is used to describe actions that are done with great intensity or volume. (किसी कार्य को अत्यधिक तीव्रता या शोर के साथ करना) • **Example: **He was working to beat the band to finish the project on time. • Hence, the idiom **'To beat the band' **means '**to a huge or the greatest possible extent.'** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To refuse to talk** (बात करने से इंकार करना): Refusing to engage in conversation. • **Example:** She decided to refuse to talk to him after their argument. • **To procrastinate** (टालमटोल करना): Delaying or postponing something. • **Example:** He tends to procrastinate on his assignments until the last minute. • **To resign from one's job** (किसी की नौकरी से इस्तीफा देना): Quitting or leaving one's job. • **Example:** She decided to resign from her job to pursue her passion for painting. 3c:Tcf5, The correct answer is: **Option 2 (All in your head)**.
